group.passage:
With gorgeous physical features and splendid landscapes, Canadian Rocky Mountains have been inscribed on the UNESCO World Heritage list since 1984. Situated in westnorthern America, the Rocky Mountains stretch for 4,800 km from Canada to New Mexico in the southwestern United States and span about 180 km in width. The exceptional natural beauty, habitats of rare species and its diverse geographic features all put Canadian Rocky Mountains on the map.
Within the provinces of British Columbia and Alberta, Canadian Rocky Mountains are a treasure trove of outdoor recreations, such as hiking, climbing, water activities and winter sports. Apart from outdoor activities, Canadian Rocky Mountains are also home to a wide diversity of wildlife and vegetation. The natural sights tourists can enjoy are alpine meadows, dense coniferous forests, and rolling grasslands. Likewise, it is highly possible for tourists to spot many amazing animals like grizzly bears, moose, or deer along the way.
Among the four national parks in Canadian Rocky Mountains, Banff in Alberta is the oldest one in Canada. One of its highlights is Lake Louise, a turquoise glacial lake adjacent to spectacular Victoria Glacier and awe-inspiring mountains, making it out of this world. To the north of Banff, Jasper National Park offers an opportunity to witness the stunning glacier and massive icefield. Undoubtedly, Columbia Icefield is the best place to experience the incredible icefield journey. Only by taking a specific vehicle called Ice Explorer can tourists walk on, feel and even drink from the glacier. Compared with these two national parks, Yoho National Park and Kootenay National park in British Columbia are much smaller.
Two routes to reach Canadian Rocky Mountains are popular with tourists. Tourists can fly to Calgary, which is the nearest city to Banff and get to Banff National Parks within two hours. The trip from Vancouver is also an option for many foreign tourists, for they don’t need a connecting flight from Vancouver to Calgary. Though it takes at least eight hours to travel to these national parks, tourists can enjoy meandering rivers, snow-capped mountains, and charming lakes all the way. Whichever route tourists choose, they definitely have time to deeply explore the glamour of Rocky Mountains.

Assiniboine Provincial Park，1 號公路西段旁有一塊斜線區塊（上面的小字無法辨識）；右上角有指北針（N 朝上），左下角有標出 British Columbia 與 Alberta 兩省位置的小地圖。四張圖的差別只在五個地名的位置：地圖最北方（16 號公路東段旁）、93N 公路中段（Jasper 與 Saskatchewan Crossing 之間）的方框、1 號公路西側城鎮、Banff 國家公園內 1 號與 93 號公路交會處的方框（其東南另一方框固定為 Banff），以及最東南方 Canmore 下方。(A) 最北方 Calgary、93N 中段 Columbia Icefield、西側 Golden、交會處 Lake Louise、東南 Edmonton；(B) 最北方 Edmonton、93N 中段 Lake Louise、西側 Golden、交會處 Columbia Icefield、東南 Calgary；(C) 最北方 Edmonton、93N 中段 Columbia Icefield、西側 Calgary、交會處 Lake Louise、東南 Golden；(D) 最北方 Edmonton、93N 中段 Columbia Icefield、西側 Golden、交會處 Lake Louise、東南 Calgary。
